turns.prompt: What are the total invoices related to cloud?

response_json.content:
All cloud-related invoices are INBOUND: 1 invoice in EUR totaling €800.00 (tax €0.00) and 3 invoices in USD totaling $73,612.43 (tax $0.00).

### Query Results


flow_direction | currency | invoice_count | total_grand_total | total_tax_amount
--- | --- | --- | --- | ---
INBOUND | EUR | 1 | 800.0 | 0.0
INBOUND | USD | 3 | 73612.43 | 0.0
response_json.generated_sql:
SELECT
  flow_direction,
  currency,
  COUNT(*) AS invoice_count,
  SUM(grand_total) AS total_grand_total,
  SUM(tax_amount) AS total_tax_amount
FROM invoice
WHERE tenant_id = '02db74f3-2064-4b3b-aec9-218af9a408f4'
  AND (
    LOWER(tags::text) LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(items::text) LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(vendor_name) LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
    OR LOWER(customer_name) LIKE LOWER('%cloud%')
  )
GROUP BY flow_direction, currency
ORDER BY currency, flow_direction;
